snapshot.text: A publicly directed system run through four regional health authorities, with municipal services handling community care. Main challenges: an ageing population, health worker shortages, and poor handovers between hospitals and municipalities. Major reform proposal now in public consultation.

minister.name: Jan Christian Vestre
minister.role: Minister of Health and Care Services

priorities.title: One Health Service hospital reform
priorities.text: A government-appointed panel's report proposes major hospital governance changes, including moving hospital trust ownership to the ministry. Public consultation runs three months; Vestre aims to deliver reform this parliamentary term.

priorities.title: Phased right to dental care
priorities.text: Draft dental legislation, sent out for consultation in October 2026, would phase in a legal entitlement to necessary dental treatment for all residents.

priorities.title: Health emergency preparedness upgrade
priorities.text: Hospitals and municipalities were asked to strengthen emergency preparedness plans, including planning for beds for war-injured patients, under the government's resilience priority.
